newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Suharto welcomes Hashimoto's return.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Suharto welcomes Hashimoto's return.

text.p: Indonesia's President Suharto on Friday welcomed the re-election of Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto, Taizo Watanabe, Japan's ambassador to Indonesia, said on Friday.

"He (Suharto) is very glad that Prime Minister Hashimoto was re-elected and continues in his post. He hopes to meet with him in Manila, when the APEC conference there takes place," Watanabe told reporters.
The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit will draw a number of national leaders to the Philippines later this month.
Watanabe was speaking after he accompanied Kimio Fujita, head of Japan's International Cooperation Agency to a meeting with Suharto.
"He really hopes that our friendly relationship will continue and further develop. That is what he said," the ambassador reported.
Watanabe said Indonesia's controversial national car policy did not come up during the meeting.
Japan, the United States and the European Union have all complained to the World Trade Organisation over the policy which they say breaks WTO rules by giving tariff and tax breaks to one firm.
Japan is Indonesia's main trading partner and major donor for Indonesian development projects.
